title: Branding for AfriScale
description: A conference campaign built to carry one clear identity from the first announcement to the live event. My work spans launch communications, registration, speaker features, partner announcements and event applications.
direction: AfriScale needed to make a broad idea feel immediate: what does growing a business with AI actually look like? I anchored the campaign in “Scaling with Intelligence” and gave that message a recognisable visual setting. The deep reds, bright highlights and recurring technology imagery establish the tone, while the white typography keeps the information direct. The aim was to make the conference feel ambitious without making its message difficult to follow.

I treated the campaign as a sequence of decisions for the audience. A teaser needs to create curiosity; a registration post needs to make the next step obvious; a speaker feature needs to establish who is speaking and why they matter. I kept the event identity consistent, but changed the scale, layout and balance of image and text to suit each job. That gives the campaign variety while keeping every piece recognisably AfriScale.

The hierarchy does much of the work. Large headlines establish the main message, supporting copy adds context, and the date, location and registration details sit in predictable places wherever the format allows. Speaker portraits bring a human presence to the technology theme. For the partnership announcement, I opened up the composition with a lighter field so the partner identity could be read clearly alongside the conference brand.

The system also had to work beyond promotional posts. The FAQ layouts make room for longer answers, the countdown gives urgency a stronger visual role, and the speaker badge reduces the message to what someone needs to recognise at the event. What matters to me is that the identity stays useful as the content changes. This collection shows how I carried the same visual language through those different demands, from building anticipation to communicating on the day.
